decisions.name: Use a Service Registry for Service Discovery
decisions.rationale: To achieve high scalability and availability, use a Service Registry to manage service instances and enable dynamic service discovery.

decisions.name: Implement Load Balancing for High Availability
decisions.rationale: To ensure high availability, implement load balancing across multiple instances of each service to distribute incoming traffic and prevent any single point of failure.

decisions.name: Use a Message Queue for Asynchronous Communication
decisions.rationale: To handle high traffic and ensure eventual consistency, use a message queue for asynchronous communication between services, allowing them to process messages independently and reducing the risk of cascading failures.

decisions.name: Implement Authentication and Authorization using OAuth
decisions.rationale: To ensure high security, implement authentication and authorization using OAuth to protect user data and prevent unauthorized access to services.

decisions.name: Use a Cloud-Native Database for High Scalability
decisions.rationale: To achieve high scalability, use a cloud-native database that can automatically scale to meet changing demands and provide high availability and performance.

decisions.name: Implement Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
decisions.rationale: To ensure high reliability, implement continuous integration and continuous deployment to automate testing, building, and deployment of services, reducing the risk of human error and improving overall quality.

decisions.name: Use a Monitoring and Alerting Tool for Real-Time Insights
decisions.rationale: To ensure high reliability and availability, use a monitoring and alerting tool to provide real-time insights into service performance and enable prompt response to any issues or anomalies.

components.name: User Service
components.responsibility: Handle user registration, authentication, and profile management.

components.name: Course Service
components.responsibility: Manage courses, lessons, and course enrollments.

components.name: Video Streaming Service
components.responsibility: Stream video lectures and handle video playback.

components.name: Notification Service
components.responsibility: Send notifications to students and instructors.

components.name: API Gateway
components.responsibility: Handle incoming requests, route them to the appropriate service, and manage authentication.

components.name: Database
components.responsibility: Store user, course, lesson, and progress data.

critique.description: The system may experience scalability issues due to the high load on the API Gateway and services.
The system may experience availability issues due to the lack of redundancy in the API Gateway and services.
The system may experience latency issues due to the use of a centralized database and lack of caching mechanisms.
The system may experience reliability issues due to the lack of error handling and logging mechanisms.
The system may experience consistency issues due to the use of eventual consistency in the distributed database.
The system may experience security issues due to the lack of authentication and authorization mechanisms.
